title: 第8章 我是你惹不起的人第9章 天水楼阁
lines: 江玄和江虎一路朝着演武场方向赶去，顿时引来了无数人的瞩目。
“你们看，是江玄！”
“看他的方向莫非是要去救那些支脉子弟？”
江玄的出现顿时引来了不少人的关注，在这一段时间以来，这个支脉子弟就犹如彗星一般崛起，一路逆袭，败江漠，强势登上藏书阁第二层，这一次他又要去挑战外府排名第七的江幻了吗？
众人纷纷猜测。
演武场。
只见在场上，一名少年被打趴在了地上，鲜血狂喷。
不过，见到江玄过来，江幻的攻击也终于停止了下来。
“江玄，你终于来啦！”
江幻居高临下，他就是在等江玄出现，好为他弟弟雪那一招之耻。
“想要救他，就上来挑战我！”
演武场上有着规矩，在双方接受挑战之后，除非有一人肯主动饶过对方，否则便需要有一人顶替那人上场继续接受挑战。
“江玄，不要上当，这里是江家，江幻不敢杀了小六子的。”
“是啊！你可千万别冲动啊！”
周围的一众支脉子弟纷纷开口劝道。
“放心吧！”
江玄说了一句，紧接着一个跨步便越上了高台，身上白色的衣袍无风自动。
“开脉境五重！”
这一幕，让无数江家子弟惊呼出声。
“这江玄竟然突破到开脉境五重了，好可怕的天赋！”
“是啊！半个月前，他可是连开脉境一重都没达到啊！这才过去多久”“难怪他敢接受江幻的挑战！”
无数人纷纷议论。
“你竟然突破到了开脉境五重？”
那江幻面色阴沉。
“是啊！前两天练着练着，一不小心就连续突破了两境，要不是我及时收住，还真怕到时候根基不稳！”
江玄摇了摇头，那平淡的语气仿佛在说一件稀松平常之事。
然而此言一出，满场哗然。
一瞬之间，连续突破两个境界，而且这还是及时收住的结果，若是收不住那岂非要上天？
“胡说八道，休要妖言惑众！”
江幻的嘴角抽搐，面色难看。
“不过是以前隐藏修为罢了，但若是你以为开脉境五重的实力就能赢得了我的话，那我只能说你太天真了一些。”
说着，他浑身灵气爆发，那灵气的强横程度竟然达到了开脉境七重。
随后，就见到江幻的手掌紧握成拳，快速的掠向江玄。
江幻的身影就像豹扑食，他双手成爪，向着江玄的腰部就抓了过去。
若是换作普通人，这一爪就能要了对方的命！“真没想到江幻也留有后招，据说这江幻曾经凝炼出了风极灵脉，所以他的速度如风，如今配合如此凶狠的攻势，这一战恐怕江玄要凶多吉少了。”
众人纷纷摇头。
“怎么，小子？
content_en:
Jiang Xuan and Jiang Hu rushed towards the martial arts arena, immediately attracting the attention of countless people.
"Look, it's Jiang Xuan!"
"Looking at his direction, could it be that he is going to save those branch children?"
The appearance of Jiang Xuan immediately attracted the attention of many people. During this period of time, this branch of the family has risen like a comet, counterattacking all the way, defeating Jiang Mo, and ascending to the second floor of the library. Is he going to challenge Jiang Huan, who is ranked seventh in the foreign palace, this time?
Everyone speculated.
A martial arts arena.
"Bang!"
On the field, a young man was beaten to the ground, blood spurting out.
However, seeing Jiang Xuan coming, Jiang Huan's attack finally stopped.
"Jiang Xuan, you are finally here!"
Jiang Huan was condescending. He was just waiting for Jiang Xuan to appear so that he could be ashamed of his brother Xue's move.
"If you want to save him, come up and challenge me!"
There are rules in the martial arts field. After both parties accept the challenge, unless one person is willing to spare the other party, another person needs to take the place of that person and continue to accept the challenge.
"Jiang Xuan, don't be fooled. This is the Jiang family. Jiang Huan doesn't dare to kill Xiao Liuzi."
"Yes! Don't be impulsive!"
All the disciples around him started to persuade him.
"Don't worry!"
Jiang Xuan said something, and then took a step up to the high platform, his white robe moving automatically without any wind.
"Fifth level of pulse opening realm!"
This scene made countless Jiang family members scream in surprise.
"Jiang Xuan has actually broken through to the fifth level of the Pulse Opening Realm. What a terrifying talent!"
"Yes! Half a month ago, he didn't even reach the first level of the Pulse Opening Realm! How long has it been?" "No wonder he dared to accept Jiang Huan's challenge!"
Countless people talked about it.
"You actually broke through to the fifth level of the Pulse Opening Realm?"
Na Jiang Huan's face was gloomy.
"Yes! I was practicing in the past two days, and I accidentally broke through two realms in a row. If I hadn't stopped in time, I would have been really afraid that my foundation would be unstable by then!"
Jiang Xuan shook his head, his calm tone seemed to be saying something ordinary.
"Wow!"
However, as soon as this statement came out, the whole place was in an uproar.
In an instant, he broke through two realms in a row, and this was the result of stopping it in time. If he couldn't stop it, wouldn't he have to go to heaven?
"You're talking nonsense, don't try to confuse the public with your monstrous words!"
The corners of Jiang Huan's mouth twitched and his face looked ugly.
"It's just that you hid your cultivation before. But if you think that you can win me with the strength of the fifth level of the Pulse Opening Realm, then I can only say that you are too naive."
As he spoke, spiritual energy burst out all over his body, and the strength of that spiritual energy actually reached the seventh level of the Pulse Opening Realm.
"Bang!"
Then, Jiang Huan's palms were clenched into fists and he quickly moved towards Jiang Xuan.
Jiang Huan's figure was like a leopard pouncing on its prey. He turned his hands into claws and grabbed Jiang Xuan's waist.
If it were an ordinary person, this claw could kill the opponent! "I really didn't expect Jiang Huan to have a back-up move. It is said that Jiang Huan once condensed the Fengji spiritual veins, so he is as fast as the wind. Now with such a fierce offensive, this battle may be more difficult for Jiang Xuan."
Everyone shook their heads.
"What, boy?
